_meta.status: Dispatch Engine v1. Only v1Ready complications can be drawn.
_meta.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: every weight below is a seeded estimate.
_meta.samplerRule: L1 draws no complication. L2 draws 0 to 1: 60% none, else one v1Ready complication weighted by weight among eligible entries (re_bleed needs a femoral bleed in the skeleton). Non-ready entries are listed with their reason so the LLM and the Nov 2 engine know what is coming.

complications.label: Vomiting mid-call
complications.trigger: Spontaneous, 3 to 8 minutes into patient contact
complications.engineEffect: modeled: fires the shared vomit path (airway soiled, patency down, aspirates unless a cuffed ETT protects). Suction is the fix.
complications.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Engine path already modeled for OPA and BVM vomit events.

complications.label: Re-bleed: control slips
complications.trigger: Active hemorrhage control loosens 5 to 10 minutes in (movement, reassessment miss)
complications.engineEffect: modeled: sets the loosened flags on whatever control is active (tourniquet, packing, dressing). Reassessment is the fix.
complications.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Loosened-flag consequences already modeled for patient movement.

complications.label: Combativeness
complications.trigger: Patient turns combative mid-call (hypoxia, head injury, intoxication)
complications.v1Note: No agitation or restraint engine exists in v1, so this cannot fire honestly. Nov 2 scope.
complications.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Listed for Nov 2; never drawn in v1.

complications.label: Rhythm change
complications.v1Note: Rhythm is derived from the shock curve in v1; no primary rhythm engine exists. Nov 2 scope.
complications.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Listed for Nov 2; never drawn in v1.

complications.label: Re-sedation after naloxone
complications.trigger: Patient re-sedates as naloxone wears off
complications.v1Note: Naloxone PK is modeled but the underlying toxidrome apnea is not, so re-sedation has nothing to return to. Nov 2 scope.
complications.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Listed for Nov 2; never drawn in v1.
